description: This file defines default configuration options for the editing component of the FooTable plugin, including callback functions and UI text options.

methods.name: enabled
methods.description: Boolean to enable or disable editing functionality.

methods.name: pageToNew
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the table should page to new rows upon creation.

methods.name: position
methods.description: Position of the editing column, default is 'right'.

methods.name: alwaysShow
methods.description: Boolean indicating if the editing controls are always visible.

methods.name: addRow
methods.description: Callback for adding a new row.

methods.name: editRow
methods.description: Callback for editing an existing row.

methods.name: deleteRow
methods.description: Callback for deleting a row.

methods.name: viewRow
methods.description: Callback for viewing a row.

methods.name: showText
methods.description: Text or HTML for the show button.

methods.name: hideText
methods.description: Text or HTML for the hide button.

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Text or HTML for the add button.

methods.name: editText
methods.description: Text or HTML for the edit button.

methods.name: deleteText
methods.description: Text or HTML for the delete button.

methods.name: viewText
methods.description: Text or HTML for the view button.

methods.name: allowAdd
methods.description: Flag to allow showing the add button.

methods.name: allowEdit
methods.description: Flag to allow showing the edit button.

methods.name: allowDelete
methods.description: Flag to allow showing the delete button.

methods.name: allowView
methods.description: Flag to allow showing the view button.

methods.name: column
methods.description: Options for the editing column, including classes, name, title, and filterable/sortable flags.
